title: Postdoctoral positions in the Computational Relativistic Astrophysics division at the Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics in Potsdam
institution: Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute)
about: Postdoctoral positions of two to three years in the Computational Relativistic Astrophysics division at the Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics in Potsdam, with access to high-performance computers at the Max Planck Computing and Data Facility. Positions available from 1 September 2027.
